cars.variant: Gran Sport — 1965 USA dual-quad Super Wildcat factory brochure reference
cars.specification_market: 1965 USA Riviera Gran Sport, first-generation 1963–1965 road family. Factory brochure PDF index 4 (printed 5) and index 23 (42–43) were visually read. Advertised horsepower and native inch units retained without gross/net or metric conversion. Gran Sport axle/package supersedes ordinary Riviera table entries. Heavy-duty suspension and faster steering are separately available, not included automatically. No standard 325-hp engine, later body generation, measured acceleration or top-speed claim imported.
cars.summary: The original Riviera Gran Sport earns a place as an American performance-GT icon by combining the distinctive first-generation Riviera with a dual-quad Super Wildcat engine, positive-traction axle and purposeful factory performance package. Its contemporary first-hand evaluation supports the driving case as well as recording handling limitations.

facts.explanation: The original Riviera Gran Sport earns a place as an American performance-GT icon by combining the distinctive first-generation Riviera with a dual-quad Super Wildcat engine, positive-traction axle and purposeful factory performance package. Its contemporary first-hand evaluation supports the driving case as well as recording handling limitations.
